limitations: Paper is closed access; only the abstract was available. Sample prep details (reduction, alkylation, gel band identity, donor demographics, fibroblast origin/cell line) are unverified.

msf search settings were read from 5 of 21 msf files (one or more per sample group); the remaining are assumed identical. Lung_Silvergel_Gelband_4 (Eclipse) and Dermal_Silvergel_Gelband_1-8 msf for Eclipse runs only partially sampled.
ImmunoPuri runs have no .msf; settings come from the Dermal StavroX file only and are applied to the Lung IP run as well (its .zhrs name indicates the same Zeropoint05Tolerance setting).
The crosslinking template was not used: disulfide bonds are native, there is no chemical cross-linker to record in comment[cross-linker].
Collision energy (NCE 27-28 seen in msf) not recorded as it was not verified for all runs.
tools reconcile raised run_names_name_another_organ (BLOCKER) based on the first row only; every Lung_* row already says lung, so it is treated as a false positive.
